Job Description
  
  

The Opportunity
  
  

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130\- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data\-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision\-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the worlds greatest health threats.


Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our company’s IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.
  
  

A focused group of leaders in each Tech Center helps to ensure we can manage and improve each location, from investing in growth, success, and well\-being of our people, to making sure colleagues from each IT division feel a sense of belonging to managing critical emergencies. And together, we must leverage the strength of our team to collaborate globally to optimize connections and share best practices across the Tech Centers.
  
  

Role Overview
  
As a Full\-Stack Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, software solutions across the UI, API, data, and cloud layers that meet business and user needs. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, product managers and delivery leads, to translate functional and non\-functional needs into high\-quality solutions, working both independently as well as a part of a global team.

* Ensure quality through automated and manual testing, code reviews, and participation in design and requirements discussions.
* Build, deploy, and operate applications on cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure), following cloud\-native best practices.
* Use DevOps tools and practices (e.g., Git, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, monitoring/observability) for versioning, deployment, and release automation.
* Apply secure development practices, including API security, authentication/authorization, and data protection.
* Gather requirements and design lifecycle practices and automation for secure, well\-engineered systems and micro\-services.
* Contribute to Product planning, execution, and delivery within a matrix organization.

* Bachelors’ degree in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
* 3\-7 years of hands\-on experience working in full\-stack development

* Web fundamentals:  HTML, CSS, HTTP, REST APIs
* Databases:  SQL and relational database design (plus practical query optimisation)
* Programming:  proficiency in at least one major stack (TypeScript/Node/React, Java, Python or .NET)
* Familiarity with cloud platforms (preferably AWS and/or Azure) and cloud\-native concepts (e.g., microservices, containerization, managed services)
* Experience with DevOps practices (Git, infrastructure as code, observability, CI/CD) and modern product development practices (Agile, Scrum, test driven development, UX, design thinking)
* Strong problem\-solving skills with a product and customer\-centric mindset
* Front end technologies like Angular, React


Secondary skills (nice to have)
  
  

* Experience with advanced frontend concepts (state management, performance optimization, accessibility)
* Exposure to data processing, analytics, or search technologies (e.g., Power BI, Elasticsearch, data pipelines)
* Experience with DevOps and observability tools (e.g., Docker, infrastructure as code, logging/monitoring solutions)
* Cloud\-native, ideally AWS certified


**Who we are:**  

We are known as Merck Co., Inc., Rahway, New Jersey, USA in the United States and Canada and MSD everywhere else. For more than a century, we have been bringing forward medicines and vaccines for many of the worlds most challenging diseases. Today, our company continues to be at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions and advance the prevention and treatment of diseases that threaten people and animals around the world.
  
  

**What we look for:**  

Imagine getting up in the morning for a job as important as helping to save and improve lives around the world. Here, you have that opportunity. You can put your empathy, creativity, digital mastery, or scientific genius to work in collaboration with a diverse group of colleagues who pursue and bring hope to countless people who are battling some of the most challenging diseases of our time. Our team is constantly evolving, so if you are among the intellectually curious, join us—and start making your impact today.

jobs.title: Software Application Development Apprenticeship, March 2027 Start
jobs.description:
This apprenticeship is intended for individuals who have graduated and want to learn and develop entry\-level technical and professional skills in software development. If you’re currently pursuing or have completed a degree in a Software Engineering (SWE)\-related field, we encourage you to browse our University Graduate \& Internship opportunities.


Application Information and Instructions:

* Apprenticeships are not a full\-time permanent opportunity, the program is 12 months in duration. While the program is open to those who are interested in software development careers, recent graduates and individuals with work experience in other industries may apply.
* Apprentices are only eligible to apply for any other full time role at Google in the last three months of their Apprenticeship program tenure
* Once onboarded, transfer of location is not permitted for apprentices.
* Applicants must include a resume with their application, clearly calling out their year of graduation.
* The whole process will spread across 18 to 24 weeks, kindly be patient during the same.
* This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship.
* This posting will be live until **August 3rd, 2026\.**

  

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurgaon, Haryana, India; Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering or a related field
* Not currently enrolled in an academic program
* Less than 1 year of experience in software application development
* Programming experience in at least one coding language

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience using Google Workspace or a similar suite of productivity tools.
* Experience thinking critically and excellent problem solving capabilities.
* Ability to learn programming language based on project requirements. Ability to work independently and within a team framework.
* Ability to navigate multiple ambiguous tasks and competing priorities while finding suitable solutions and seeking help/advice where appropriate.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills, self\-motivated, positive attitude, and excellent customer service capabilities.
* Enthusiasm and passion for new technologies, demonstrated through personal projects and commitment to learning new skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


The Google Software Application Development Apprenticeship is a learning and development program for 12 months, Apprentices are expected to join in person at their assigned in\-office and participate full\-time (\~40 hours, weekly) throughout the program. The program includes work experience with a Google team supported by external training to empower those looking to start a career in Software Application Development.You will spend 20% of your time studying in a tailored training program and the rest of the time on projects with assigned Google teams to gain hands\-on experience.


As a Software Application Development Apprentice at Google, you will develop the skills you need to pursue an entry\-level career in software development. You will get exposure to a range of different roles across the company including coding, development, testing, and project management. Additionally, you will learn how to apply problem solving skills to real\-life challenges, pick up new technical skills such as programming in multiple languages, learn about software testing and other industry practices, and see how software is designed and developed.


At Google, we don’t just accept differences — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community.  

  

Apprenticeships contribute towards the development of digital skills by providing opportunities for work and study. They can serve as part of your journey to a meaningful career. During the program, apprentices get exposure to different areas and teams at Google, while receiving external training and developing their professional skills on the job.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Learn and follow coding standards and ensure compliance with quality measures.
* Support your team in the development of software based on agreed projects and platforms. Contribute to most aspects of development including implementation, unit testing, and integration to ensure high quality deliverables.
* Apply knowledge gained in apprenticeship to real world applications.
* Ensure code is tested in accordance with the guidelines provided by the team or your manager.
Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

jobs.title: Deputy Manager-Production ( Drug Product )
jobs.description:
***Be the First to Apply***

**Division**


Piramal Critical Care
Piramal Critical Care (PCC), a business unit of Piramal Pharma, is the fourth\-largest producer of inhaled anesthetics and a global player in hospital generics. We are motivated by our vision of commitment to delivering critical care solutions for patients and healthcare providers across the globe while achieving sustainable and profitable growth for all the stakeholders.


PCC maintains a wide presence across the US, Europe, and more than 100 countries across the globe. Its rich product portfolio includes Inhalation Anesthetics such as Sevoflurane, Isoflurane and Halothane as well as Intrathecal Baclofen therapy, for spasticity management.


PCC has a strong manufacturing and process development experience with wholly\-owned, state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in the United States and India, inspected periodically by the US FDA and the UK MHRA and other regulators. The strategic locations of our facilities help us supply high\-quality products around the world, timely at optimal costs.


For more details, please visit https://www.piramalcriticalcare.com/global/


Job Title


Deputy Manager\-Production ( Drug Product )
Job Description


The role is responsible for executing filling and packing operations in compliance with approved Batch Filling Records (BFR), Batch Packing Records (BPR), Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP). The incumbent ensures timely completion of production activities, maintenance of accurate manufacturing records, adherence to data integrity requirements, and compliance with quality, safety, and regulatory standards. The position involves material verification, finished goods handling, equipment and area cleanliness, environmental monitoring, SAP transactions, and coordination with cross\-functional departments such as QA, QC, Stores, Engineering \& Maintenance, and Supply Chain Management. Additionally, the role is responsible for documentation activities including deviations, change controls, CAPA, market complaints, SOP preparation/revision, and batch record review, while supporting uninterrupted plant operations and maintaining production efficiency.
Job Summary:\*\*  

  

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Deputy Manager\-Production to oversee and optimize drug product manufacturing operations at our state\-of\-the\-art facility. This role involves ensuring efficient production, adherence to quality standards, and continuous process improvement.  

  

Job Responsibilities:\*\*  

  

* Lead and supervise a team of production operators and technicians, ensuring high performance and adherence to safety protocols.
* Plan, organize, and control daily production activities to meet manufacturing targets and schedules for drug products.
* Monitor and troubleshoot production processes, identifying and implementing solutions to optimize efficiency and minimize downtime.
* Ensure strict compliance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), regulatory requirements (e.g., FDA, MHRA), and company Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Review and approve batch manufacturing records, deviations, CAPAs, and other production\-related documentation.
* Participate in investigations of deviations, non\-conformances, and quality incidents, implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Collaborate with Quality Assurance, Engineering, and Supply Chain departments to ensure seamless operations and timely product release.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, including process optimization, waste reduction, and cost\-saving measures.
* Provide training and development to production staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill enhancement.
* Prepare and present production reports to senior management, highlighting key performance indicators and areas for improvement.

  

Job Qualifications:\*\*  

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Pharmacy, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific discipline.
* 18 \- 12 years of experience in pharmaceutical manufacturing, with at least 2\-3 years in a supervisory or leadership role within drug product production.
* In\-depth knowledge of GMP, regulatory guidelines (e.g., ICH, USFDA, EMA), and quality systems relevant to pharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Proven experience in managing and optimizing manufacturing processes for various drug product formulations (e.g., tablets, capsules, injectables, liquids).
* Strong understanding of manufacturing equipment and technologies used in pharmaceutical production.
* Excellent leadership, team management, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Demonstrated problem\-solving abilities and a proactive approach to process improvement.
* Proficiency in using manufacturing execution systems (MES) and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, regulated environment and manage multiple priorities.

Bachelor of Science (BSc)Batch Manufacturing Record (BMR), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), Product Manufacturing

Head of Sales and Marketing – India

Company: DOCK\-Y Tech Limited

Location: India – Mumbai/Pune/Bengaluru/Hyderabad

Role Type: Full\-time

Function: Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, Business Development

Industry: Premium Mobility, Electric Two\-Wheelers, Lifestyle Products, Automobile Retail

About DOCK\-Y

DOCK\-Y is a technology driven mobility company headquartered in Warwick, England. The team is building next generation active mobility products with a strong focus on safety, intelligent design, and advanced rider assist systems. The company aims to redefine premium urban mobility for India’s next generation of riders, with a sharp focus on HNIs, urban professionals, corporate fleets, and luxury lifestyle segments.

Role Overview

The Head of Sales and Marketing – India will be responsible for creating, leading and executing DOCK\-Y’s sales and marketing strategy across India.

This is a critical leadership role. The strength and success of the business will be defined by how effectively sales are built, managed and delivered. The ideal candidate must have a proven track record of selling premium, aspirational, lifestyle or automobile products across India and must be able to generate sales from the first month itself.

The role requires a hands\-on leader who can build a national sales structure, hire and manage regional sales teams, develop city\-level partnerships, drive customer conversions, support marketing campaigns and deliver measurable revenue outcomes.

We are looking for a high\-energy, entrepreneurial and commercially sharp sales leader with a strong background in premium product sales.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
We are seeking a motivated, skilled and collaborative Frontend Developer who is ready to help us to make beautiful, elegant and responsive digital experiences at LSEG.


If that is who you are then our Digital Design capability at LSEG is looking for someone just like you to join our diverse team and be part of our Experience Engineering team of front end developers.


We are keen to find that special someone who will take delight in showcasing our FTSE Russell indices and data and will take personal satisfaction in making our collective vision come to life.


When you join you will find yourself working alongside a group of skilled, motivated and passionate people in design, accessibility, publishing and data visualisation. You will be an integral part of building brilliant, data\-rich experiences for our customers. You will bind together our Forge Design System and our agile scrum teams experiences. You will learn and you will teach, and you will be part of a team that we are all proud of.


If you have strong skills in React, Node.js, accessibility (a11y), and Git, along with a passion for interactive charts, graphs, and data tables then tell us more about you and how you could help us.


Why not Join Us?


* Work on high\-impact digital experiences for FTSE Russell and other LSEG experiences.


* Contribute to a design\-led agile environment passionate about innovation and quality.


* Collaborate across the globe with our team of UX, engineering, and product owners


* Shape and extend our Forge Design System and React component library.


Key Responsibilities you can look forward to


* Develop and maintain customer facing digital applications using your front end skills and our Forge design system components.


* Implement data driven components and pages for FTSE Russell content using libraries such as D3\.js, Highcharts, Chart.js, and ag\-Grid.


* Collaborate with UX, QA, and delivery teams to ensure design consistency and technical quality.


* Apply best practices for performance, accessibility (WCAG), and responsive design.


* Manage version control and branching strategies using Git.


* Troubleshoot and resolve complex frontend issues.


* Know the latest to stay ahead of frontend technologies and trends.


Technical Skills that will help us to know it could be match


* React (primary), familiarity with Vue or Angular.


* Charting/Data Visualization: D3\.js, Highcharts, Chart.js.


* Data Tables: ag\-Grid or similar.


* CSS3 and Styling: SASS/PostCSS, modular CSS (BEM).


* Accessibility: WCAG compliance.


* Build Tools: Webpack, NPM/Yarn.


* Testing: JEST, Enzyme.


* Version Control \& CI/CD: Git, Jenkins.


* CMS Platforms: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or Sitecore.


* API Integration: RESTful services.


* Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) front end components

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field, or, if you have outstanding relevant experience, then let us know...


* Confirmed experience collaborating to build web applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and modern frameworks (React is our core frontend development language).


* Experience with Git and agile development methodologies.


* Strong problem\-solving skills using your technical knowledge and your collaboration behaviours


* Thoughtful communication practices to understand and unpick requirements into phenomenal solutions

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high\-quality products that resonate with clients.  

As a Product Manager in consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end\-to\-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top\-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams to deliver high\-quality products that exceed customer expectations.  

**Job responsibilities*** Develops a product strategy and product vision that delivers value to customers
* Manages discovery efforts and market research to uncover customer solutions and integrate them into the product roadmap
* Identifies customer needs and pain points through research and feedback, translating insights into business cases for new features
* Acts as the primary point of contact for stakeholders regarding platform capabilities and roadmap
* Resolves stakeholder issues by providing timely support and ensuring effective communication
* Translates business requirements into clear product specifications and user stories
* Oversees the product lifecycle from ideation to launch and ongoing optimization
* Ensures the platform meets security, compliance, and reliability standards




**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** 5\+ years of experience or equivalent expertise in product management or a relevant domain area
* Strong understanding of streaming data technologies such as Apache Kafka, Flink, Trino, Clickhouse Spark Streaming, AWS Kinesis, or Azure Event Hubs
* Experience with cloud platforms, including AWS, and modern data architectures
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams in a matrixed organization
* Ability to translate technical concepts into business value and vice versa
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Demonstrated ability to execute operational management and change readiness activities




**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills*** Demonstrated prior experience working in a highly matrixed, complex organization
* Experience in working with real\-time analytics
* Proficient knowledge of product development in streaming and real\-time platforms
* Experience in product or platform\-wide release management and deployment strategies
* Strong understanding of delivery and a proven track record of implementing continuous improvement processes
* Exposure to cloud technologies

  



  

**ABOUT US**  

  

  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  

  

  

**ABOUT THE TEAM**  

  

  

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most\-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.  

  

The CCB Data \& Analytics team responsibly leverages data across Chase to build competitive advantages for the businesses while providing value and protection for customers.  Commercial Engineering \& AI (CEAI) partners closely with stakeholders to accelerate the transformation of Microsoft’s commercial business into a frontier organization. We bring together AI‑native engineering, modern platforms, and deep commercial insight to reimagine how work gets done \- at scale and with impact. Our mission is to unlock new ways of operating through intelligent systems while creating the conditions for our teams to do the most meaningful work of their careers. If you’re excited to build, experiment, and shape the future of commercial execution with AI at the core, we invite you to apply.
   

  

 As part of CEAI, the Support Experience Group (SxG) is leading the transformation of Microsoft’s support ecosystem into an AI\-first, agent\-powered model. We build intelligent platforms and reusable AI agents that diagnose, guide, and resolve customer issues—improving time\-to\-resolution and enabling engineers to focus on complex, high\-value scenarios.

 **Product Manager – Builder**

Success in this role is measured not by features shipped, but by the impact delivered to customers, support operations, and Microsoft's AI\-first transformation.

**Description**
 TimeHub team's charter is to build a world\-class product which meets time, attendance and pay computation needs for over 2 Million hourly associates across Amazon businesses. People Technology is the central hub for all Amazon people data. Our product and technology provides the foundation for a multitude of key human resource processes, from on\-boarding of tens of thousands of temporary employees during peak holiday season, capturing time\-related events across an associate's day to day activities, to integrating critical employee data to internal and external systems. We implement and build highly secure, global software that allows Amazon to effectively manage the workforce, resulting in a better employee experience and a better bottom line.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Manage the TimeHub product roadmap for a country, balancing business priorities with customer needs
* Drive execution for key product areas, including pay calculation and time tracking systems
* Partner with engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders to develop scalable, customer\-centric solutions that serve millions of users
* Analyze complex product requirements and translate them into clear, actionable plans that guide cross\-functional teams
* Leverage data analysis and customer feedback to inform product decisions, measure success, and drive continuous improvement


 A day in the life
   

  

 In this role, you'll focus on the TimeHub product ecosystem, which serves as the foundation for time and attendance management across Amazon's global operations. You'll spend your time collaborating with engineering and design teams to translate complex business requirements into clear product strategies. You might start your day reviewing customer feedback and data insights to inform prioritization decisions, then move into a working session with operations stakeholders to understand how recent product changes are impacting their workflows. You'll also present product progress to senior leadership, using data to support your recommendations. Throughout the week, you'll partner with multiple stakeholders for the country you lead to ensure our solutions address diverse business needs while maintaining security and scalability. Beyond routine product management, you'll occasionally dive deep into analyzing market trends or conducting customer discovery sessions to uncover new opportunities for the roadmap.
   

  

**About The Team**
 We are a collaborative group of product leaders, engineers, designers, and operations specialists dedicated to building secure, scalable solutions that power workforce management at Amazon's scale. Our team spans multiple geographies and works closely with business stakeholders to understand the evolving needs of our associates and the organization. We're focused on creating products that simplify complex processes—whether that's onboarding thousands of temporary employees during peak season or ensuring accurate pay computation across diverse business models. As a Senior Product Manager, you'll be instrumental in shaping our product vision and helping us deliver solutions that make a tangible difference in how Amazon manages and supports its workforce. We're excited to work with someone who brings strategic thinking, customer empathy, and a commitment to operational excellence.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree
* 4\+ years of customer\-facing product development and product management, including defining, launching, and optimizing product and services experience
* Experience with feature priotization and product roadmap tradeoffs
* Experience working with engineering and technical teams to build automated solutions
* Experience with end to end product delivery


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Knowledge of agile product development and life\-cycle management process
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams to deliver products and online services on tight deadlines

jobs.title: Product Manager - Tech, Amazon Travel and Events

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Amazon's travel, events, and expense programmes serve employees at an unprecedented scale, with a mission to deliver an employee\-centric experience that lets them be more productive, while also helping to manage costs, safety, and sustainability. Today that experience is fragmented across too many systems, partners, and manual processes. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager \- Technical to own the product strategy that consolidates these into a unified platform, dramatically reducing cost\-to\-serve while delivering a self\-service experience employees prefer over the alternatives.
   

  

 You'll partner with engineering, science, and design teams alongside third\-party partners to deliver intelligent automation, personalized experiences, and modern customer service capabilities. AI\-powered intelligent personalization and automation are tools in your toolkit, not the job description itself. You should be energized by applying them to genuinely eliminate friction, not just modernize the wrapper around legacy processes. This requires someone who takes ownership of ambiguous problems, makes hard build\-vs\-buy calls, and delivers measurable results at pace.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Define product requirements for self\-service capabilities that reduce support contacts, eliminate manual work, and cut expense processing time.
* Evaluate and apply emerging AI capabilities for knowledge orchestration, intelligent routing, and agentic automation, to deliver measurable product improvements.
* Collaborate with technical programme managers and engineering teams to translate product vision into high\-quality technical solutions
* Drive the product strategy for shifting from fragmented third\-party dependencies to first\-party platform ownership, informing build\-vs\-buy decisions that permanently restructure the cost base
* Lead and develop a team of product managers and analysts; hire bar\-raising talent
* Influence cross\-functional global teams across finance, HR, and workplace technology to resolve dependencies and deliver shared outcomes
* Partner with customer services teams to set new program\-level success metrics (adoption, cost\-to\-serve, customer satisfaction) and use data to drive prioritization
* Write compelling narratives, strategy documents, and business cases to contribute to executive alignment, investment, and cross\-organizational resourcing for transformation initiatives


 A day in the life
   

  

 Start with a backlog review with your team, sharpening acceptance criteria for a self\-service workflow that eliminates a manual handoff. Move to a design sprint with engineers where you're debating trade\-offs between two integration approaches and deciding which to prototype first. Progress with synthesizing customer feedback into a revised requirements doc, then pressure\-testing priorities with an existing third\-party partner. End the day with a quick check on adoption metrics from last month's release, turning what you learn into next sprint's input. You build first, then let the data tell you what to build next.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Amazon Travel \& Events exists to make every business trip and event seamless, safe, and cost\-effective for over 500,000 employees across 64 countries. Our Technology \& Data Solutions team is the builder behind that mission, designing the platforms and data capabilities that let employees plan, book, and manage travel and events and expense re\-imbursements with as little effort as possible. We partner across Amazon's enterprise to improve the employee experience, reduce programme costs, strengthen duty of care, and advance sustainability goals. We're a mix of builders, analysts, and domain experts united by one principle: make it easy.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive\-level prioritization and planning
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 7\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Experience working with global teams and diverse partners


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Prior relative experience in corporate travel and events, expense management, or payments

* Ability to review deliverables for completeness, quality, and compliance with established project standards.
* Exceptional ability to work productively in a matrix management environment across geography, departments and position level
* Ability to resolve conflict (striving for win\-win outcomes); ability to execute with limited information and ambiguity
* Analytical skills, highly focused, team player, versatile, resourceful
* Effective under pressure, time management skills
* Precise communication skills, including an ability to project clarity and precision in verbal and written communication and strong presentation skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and critical thinking skills exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to be flexible with job responsibilities and workflow changes.
* Ability to identify process improvements and implement changes
* Ability to understand and become proficient with the expense allocation process
* Ability to analyze and review financial output for reasonability and trends
* Ability to provide insights into what the data is saying, not just the numbers
* Analytical mind with outstanding ability to collect and analyze data; experience working with large data sets for research and analytics

Qualified candidates will typically have 8 \- 11 years of progressive experience in financial analysis, cost accounting and system support. **Junior QA Analyst – Data \& Analytics** **Role Summary**
We are seeking a Junior QA Analyst to support testing and quality assurance activities across data engineering, data science, analytics, and integration projects. The role will focus on validating data pipelines, ETL processes, data quality, reports, dashboards, and business rules to ensure accurate and reliable data is delivered to stakeholders.**Key Responsibilities*** Execute test cases for data pipelines, ETL processes, APIs, and reporting solutions.
* Validate source\-to\-target data mappings and perform data reconciliation checks.
* Write and execute SQL queries to verify data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.
* Perform data quality testing, including row count validation, duplicate checks, null checks, referential integrity, and business rule validation.
* Validate dashboards, reports, and analytical outputs against business requirements.
* Work closely with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, Business Analysts, and stakeholders to understand data flows and expected outcomes.
* Investigate and document defects, data issues, and root causes.
* Assist in the creation and maintenance of test plans, test cases, and QA documentation.
* Participate in UAT, regression testing, and release validation activities.
* Support continuous improvement of QA processes and test automation initiatives.

**Required Skills \& Experience*** Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases.
* Ability to read, analyze, and validate data from multiple sources.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts, data pipelines, and data transformations.
* Knowledge of data quality concepts such as completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.
* Ability to understand business requirements and validate how data is used within reports, dashboards, and operational processes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Familiarity with Excel and data analysis techniques.

**Desirable Skills*** Exposure to AWS, Azure, or cloud\-based data platforms.
* Knowledge of reporting tools such as Power BI, QuickSight, Tableau, or GoodData.
* Understanding of data science workflows, datasets, model inputs/outputs, and feature validation.
* Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar testing and defect management tools.
* Exposure to Python for basic data validation or testing activities.

**Ideal Candidate**
A detail\-oriented graduate or early\-career professional who is passionate about data, enjoys investigating problems, understands how businesses use data for decision\-making, and wants to build a career in Data Quality, Data Engineering, Analytics, or Data Science QA.

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Business Transformation Analyst, Supply Chain will be based in Hyderabad, India and will support Project Phoenix across the Source to Pay (S2P), Make to Deliver (M2D), and Forecast to Plan (F2P) workstreams. This role will work closely with business stakeholders, track leads, IT, and implementation partners to improve process clarity, maintain requirements traceability, support testing readiness, and help drive cutover preparation for Oracle transformation activities. The role emphasize is on data accuracy, cross\-functional coordination, reporting, process discipline, and strong execution in a fast\-paced environment.

 This position plays a key role in helping NextPower translate business process requirements into structured, testable, and executable project outputs. The analyst will partner with global and Hyderabad\-based teams to support business process design, scenario preparation, issue tracking, reporting, and readiness activities across CRP, SIT, UAT, and cutover. The role requires a detail\-oriented, analytical, and collaborative professional who can connect business needs with disciplined project execution.

* Support Project Phoenix execution across S2P, M2D, and F2P by coordinating requirements, action items, dependencies, and follow\-ups across business, IT, and implementation teams.
* Prepare and organize CRP1 and CRP2 scope, business scenarios, test data inputs, and session materials to support structured walkthroughs and design validation.
* Coordinate with Hyderabad\-based and global stakeholders to ensure timely completion of workstream deliverables, issue resolution, and decision closure across time zones.

* Support UAT readiness and execution by preparing scripts, coordinating end\-to\-end business testing, tracking issues, and helping assemble business sign\-off evidence.
* Assist with data conversion and validation activities, including field mapping support, test load coordination, reconciliation follow\-up, and pre\-cutover readiness checks.
* Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, status summaries, KPI tracking, and executive\-ready updates to support business and program decisions.
* Identify process gaps, execution risks, and improvement opportunities, and contribute to practical solutions that improve standardization, quality, and delivery discipline.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in business analysis, transformation, supply chain operations, ERP\-enabled process improvement, or program support roles.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and communicate information with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and functions.
* Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and drive follow\-through in a dynamic transformation environment.
* Familiarity with dashboards, KPI reporting, and data\-driven decision support.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience in ERP transformation and/or supporting Oracle, Anaplan, or related ERP / planning platforms.

**Description**
 The Business Analyst role family focuses on using data analysis and business knowledge to solve problems and drive decisions.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 You use data and your understanding of business objectives to solve straightforward problems to drive decision(s) and action(s) within a workflow. You analyze straightforward or previously\-defined business and/or data processes to drive improvement. Your work is tactical, where you take actions to achieve a defined goal. Those actions require you to set success measurements and priorities and engage with others in a team as necessary to deliver.
   

  

 The problems you solve are well\-defined by a combination of stakeholder requests, business requirements, and direction from your manager and your team. The tasks you work on involve well\-defined subject areas with clear requirements, deliverables, and timelines. You use your knowledge and skills to build, implement, and/or meet assigned goals. Your work is reviewed periodically. As your solutions may need refinement, you solicit guidance from your manager or your team to deliver results that meet relevant requirements and timelines.
   

  

 You know your team’s business objectives and use your domain knowledge to provide analytics solutions. You understand how the domain you support relates to the broader business. You extract readily available data and apply basic transformations (e.g., applying if\-then logic, aggregating data at different intervals, calculating metric ratios) and analysis in spreadsheets, SQL, and other relevant tools to solve problems. You use descriptive analysis (e.g., pivots, groupings of metrics by attributes, creation of process flows) to understand impact and identify drivers. You ask questions to clarify requirements and determine if and when a new solution is required. You make tradeoffs between time and resources.
   

  

 You recognize similar problems and apply existing solutions to solve them faster. When a problem requires building a net\-new solution, you use existing assets and knowledge of what exists within your team to avoid duplication. You assess your work for quality and accuracy, validating against existing sources of truth.
   

  

 Your analytics solutions generate findings that are inputs to your team or stakeholders and help solve straightforward problems. You provide descriptive analyses to support team metrics. Your work informs decisions by providing visibility to business performance, highlighting anomalies and systemic outliers, or revealing new opportunities. You help to improve scalability in your team through documentation, accessibility, and replicability. You automate manual, repetitive work.
   

  

 You document your analytical approach including metric definitions, applied logic, assumptions, and sources. You make data and findings easily accessible to your team through documentation highlighting analytical approach (e.g., business problem, metric definitions, applied logic, assumptions, data sources). Your analytics solutions are consumable by your customers and replicable by other analysts and engineers, helping to make similar work simpler in the future. You help train new peers.
   

  

 You share findings with your team or stakeholders through written and verbal communication channels. You are learning to be clear and concise in your communication. When communicating, you consider the business context and audience and tailor appropriately. Your work may also be shared through mechanisms owned by others, such as WBR callouts, email flashes, and/or documents. While you may not own these communications end\-to\-end, you are an important part of their creation. You manage meetings effectively. You are learning to put the right people in the room. You are trusted to present decisions to leaders up to three tiers above your level (L7\). You are learning to communicate across an increasing diversity of locales and roles.
   

  

 You seek and/or support representation and equity for marginalized voices within organizational systems, assessing barriers to authentic contribution or participation. You demonstrate a willingness to challenge the status quo. You are learning to build products and services to benefit those on the margins and minimizing the ways products and services may perpetuate inequity.

jobs.title: Manager - Product Security
jobs.description:
**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Assist in the day\-to\-day management of the Product Security program, providing secure development and application security services across multiple product and engineering teams. This includes secure SDLC implementation, application security monitoring, vulnerability management, threat modeling, and security policy enforcement.
* Define and track key program metrics, including Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), to measure the effectiveness of the Product Security program and assess product and application security risks across the organization.
* Partner with engineering, architecture, DevOps, cloud, and business stakeholders to embed security controls, automate policy enforcement, and identify opportunities for secure technology integrations within product ecosystems.
* Collaborate with third\-party vendors and internal teams to conduct application security assessments, penetration testing, secure code reviews, and red team exercises across products and platforms.
* Support and coordinate Product Security incident response activities, including triage, investigation, remediation guidance, and escalation management for application and product\-related security incidents.
* Lead and mentor Product Security engineers and analysts by establishing clear goals, deliverables, development plans, performance feedback, coaching, and operational metrics.
* Oversee the planning and execution of vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, threat modeling, and security reviews for products, applications, APIs, and cloud\-native platforms. Drive remediation and risk reduction strategies for identified vulnerabilities across product lines.
* Manage the execution of tactical and strategic Product Security initiatives through effective coordination of cross\-functional teams, with accountability for deliverables, timelines, resource planning, and operational outcomes.
* Stay current with industry best practices, emerging threats, secure development frameworks, cloud security standards, and regulatory guidance related to product and application security.
* Lead the development and enhancement of Product Security policies, standards, procedures, and secure engineering guidelines to address evolving application, API, cloud, and software supply chain threats.


Lead and/or contribute to Product Security transformation initiatives, security tooling enhancements, DevSecOps integrations, compliance activities, and other strategic projects assigned by leadership.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Why You Belong Here**
-----------------------


At Victoria’s Secret \& Co, you’ll join a world\-leading specialty retail brand recognized globally for innovation and excellence in lingerie and fashion. You’ll work alongside industry leaders to set the standard for what a retail brand can achieve, placing customers at the center of everything we do to create products and experiences that bring them joy.

  

We believe everyone deserves a place where they truly belong. We celebrate individuality and know that your passion, experience, and unique perspective strengthen our team and business. Here, you’ll be empowered to perform, grow, and engage through unmatched opportunities to develop your skills, gain real\-world experience, and learn from the best in the business.

**Description**
Software Engineer (MicroStrategy)


The primary purpose of this role is to provide production support to the MicroStrategy /Looker reporting platforms.


Responsibilities:

* Analyze day\-to\-day production issues reported by business, provide work around or permanent code fixes to resolve issues.
* Provide multi\-tiered application support including \- incident management, user, application and data issues, system availability and maintenance including on\-call responsibilities as assigned.
* Analyze the performance and system capabilities continuously to identify and implement Continuous Service Improvements into the system.
* Design and develop and support schema objects, build grids, graphs, reports, documents, dashboards, and dossiers.
* Collaborate with product managers, business, and application platform teams to develop efficient and scalable reporting solutions.
* Review and approve code changes made by the development team to ensure that quality of code and deliverables are met before production rollouts.
* Support business users in their daily MicroStrategy \& Looker reporting issues, report failures and data refresh issues and engage relevant teams to troubleshoot and resolve.
* Assist the business with ad\-hoc and standard service requests that will involve complex analysis in MicroStrategy.
**Qualifications**
Education:

* Bachelor’s Degree : (Engineering/BCA/B.SC (Comp Sc)/MCA)


Required Qualifications

* 3 \- 5 years of experience in production support to the MicroStrategy reporting platforms
* Strong expertise in MicroStrategy Architect, Developer/Desktop, Web, Dossier, and Administration.
* Hands\-on experience with Snowflake as the reporting database.
* Strong SQL development and query optimization skills.
* Good understanding of Data Warehousing, ETL, and dimensional modeling.
* Experience in creating schema and application objects in MicroStrategy.
* Knowledge of Intelligent Cubes, Report Services, Distribution Services, and Object Manager.
* Experience with performance tuning and troubleshooting BI applications.
* Excellent dossier design skillset, including UI/visualization aspects.
* Strong RDBMS skills that include writing complex SQL queries
* Good knowledge of MicroStrategy Object Manager, Integrity Manager, Command Manager, Web SDK, multi\-sourcing
* Good Knowledge of Looker and LookML
* Experience with scripting languages like Python
* Strong understanding of retail technology and supporting business processes.
* Exposure in Control M enterprise scheduling tool
* Perform performance tuning and query optimization.
* Exposure on distribution services and transaction services
* Experience in Agile applications, JIRA, and Confluence
* Excellent interpersonal skills are necessary to work effectively with all levels of the organization and geographically distributed teams including onshore.

jobs.title: Manager, Paid Media
jobs.description:
**About Learneo**  

Learneo is a platform of builder\-driven businesses, including Course Hero, CliffsNotes, LitCharts, Quillbot, Symbolab, and Scribbr, all united around a shared mission of supercharging productivity and learning for everyone. We attract and scale high growth businesses built and run by visionary entrepreneurs. Each team innovates independently but has a unique opportunity to collaborate, experiment, and grow together, and they are supported by centralized corporate operations functions, including HR, Finance and Legal.

**About Quillbot**  

Quillbot was founded in 2017 with a mission to help students and professionals—especially those learning English—strengthen their writing. Today, we help over 56 million people around the world create great things. Whether you're writing, designing, coding, or collaborating, Quillbot is a place where anyone can create at the speed of thought. Our AI\-powered tools help you think clearly, communicate effectively, and create beautifully—across every platform, in any format, at any skill level. If you're passionate about using technology to make the path from inspiration to execution more accessible, intentional, and relevant, come join us.


**Role Overview**  

We're seeking a data\-driven and strategic Manager for Paid Media to lead our paid marketing initiatives. This role is pivotal in driving scalable growth, optimizing media performance, and contributing to our full\-funnel marketing strategy. You'll work cross\-functionally with other Marketing teams, Data, Engineering, Product and Finance teams to improve our performance


**Responsibilities**


* Lead the Paid Media budget plan and allocation strategy across products, geos, languages, and channels, optimizing for Return on Investment and Lifetime Value
* Own end\-to\-end campaign strategy and execution across multiple platforms: Google Search, DV360, PMax, Meta, UAC, and ASA, among others. From strategy and setup to bid management and creative testing programs.
* Own audience strategy across the funnel, including segmentation, remarketing, and lookalike audiences, to maximize reach efficiency and conversion
* Define the measurement framework: own attribution infrastructure, incrementality testing, and Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) to ensure investment decisions are grounded in causal evidence. Work in close collaboration with the Data and Engineering team.
* Manage relationships with agencies, platform partnerships, and vendor agreements, including negotiations, renewals, and performance accountability
* Build, develop, and mentor the paid media team, set clear goals, improve ways of working, and create conditions for high performance
* Deliver regular performance reporting tied to business outcomes, CAC, ROAS, LTV, CPI, with clear recommendations for leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders
* Continuously evaluate and pilot emerging ad formats, AI\-powered campaign types (incl. AI Max), and platform innovations to keep the paid media function ahead of market shifts
* Articulate the investment plan and performance results in structured presentation and reporting formats
* Run structured A/B tests across ads, landing pages, and bidding strategies; translate results into scalable improvements
* Build and manage a global affiliate program, designing commission models that drive incremental sales
* Partner with Data, Product, Finance, and Legal to align paid media investments with broader growth and profitability goals


**Qualifications**


* 7\-12 years in Paid Media, Growth Marketing and Performance Marketing.
* Full\-funnl campaigns and global media strategies knowledge
* Proven track record managing large\-scale paid campaigns across multiple channels
* Strong analytical mindset with expertise in attribution, media mix modeling, incrementality and full\-funnel metrics
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams with strong bias to negotiation and peer influence
* Comfortable with data platforms, dashboards, and a hands\-on approach to tools such as Google Ads, Meta Ads, DV360, GA4, TikTok Ads Manager, and Looker
* Experience with Affiliate marketing
* Background on DTC and B2C. Previous experience on subscription\-based business models desired.
* Managerial experience with remote teams
* Experience on selecting and managing Media Agencies overseas
* Familiarity with AI and writing tools is a bonus.


**Benefits \& Perks**


* Competitive salary and annual bonus
* Medical coverage
* Life and accidental insurance
* Vacation \& leaves of absence (menstrual, flexible, special, and more!)
* Developmental opportunities through education \& developmental reimbursements \& professional workshops
* Maternity \& parental leave
* Hybrid \& remote model with flexible working hours
* On\-site \& remote company events throughout the year
* Tech \& WFH stipends \& new hire allowances
* Employee referral program
* Premium access to Quillbot


* Benefits and benefit amounts differ by region. A comprehensive list applicable to your region will be provided in your interview process.



This role is eligible for hire in India.



We are a virtual\-first company with employees across the United States, Canada, India, Germany, and the Netherlands. Our compensation approach is market\-based and varies by location while ensuring fairness, consistency, and transparency.



The base pay for this role is determined by several factors, including:


* Relevant professional experience
* Skills and expertise
* Scope and responsibilities of the role
* Internal equity considerations


In addition to base salary, total compensation may include bonus, equity, and benefits. Eligibility depends on role, level, and location.



We are committed to equal pay for equal work, and all compensation decisions are made using consistent, gender\-neutral criteria in alignment with pay transparency requirements.

jobs.title: Data Strategy - Custody Product Development, AVP India - LDM-3
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

The Product organization is recruiting for the lead role covering Corporate Actions, Income, Tax and Corporate Governance supporting Global Head of Custody Product Development globally.


The individual will partner with the Product team, Global Delivery (operations) and Technology to execute on the overall custody product development initiatives and agenda, in alignment with Custody product strategic objective to strengthen State Street’s position in the industry. State Street’s product organization is leading an exciting period of transformation for the business and requires experienced leaders to take the business forward.


The role will Initiate and support designing, developing solutions and closing product gaps to support client retention, client growth, enhance client experience and operating framework including product standards for Asset Servicing, including drive and oversee execution of approved product change/development. The focus of the role is building out the SME/BA capabilities within asset servicing practice in Custody covering across all key segments – asset managers, asset owners, SWF and FIs


***Function***

As the lead you will establish the Asset servicing practice that has the depth and expertise to effectively execute on the overall custody product development initiatives and agenda described above. The role reports to the Head of Custody Product Development.


The role requires you to be proactively involved in the assessment of available market intelligence (trends, innovations, regulations, market changes) and stakeholder feedback (clients and coverage/product management) to support the evolution of the custody business.


***Responsibilities***

* The AVP will have responsibility for the following
* **Leading a project in support delivery of the Asset Servicing / Core Custody product roadmap** , working in collaboration with Custody Product Value Stream Lead and contributing analysis, execution input, and dependency management.
* **Assist with the analysis of product‑related change** , including development of commercially viable and client‑focused business cases, and support prioritization of product, operational, and regulatory change in collaboration with Product Management, Technology, and Global Delivery.
* **Lead delivery activities remain aligned with applicable regulation and internal policies** , escalating issues and risks as appropriate.
* **Contribute to external and internal market awareness** by gathering industry intelligence and participating in relevant forums and working groups to inform product and capability evolution.
* **Support governance activities** , including compliance with policies and frameworks, and assist with tracking and oversight of issues, risks, audit, and compliance items related to assigned initiatives.
* **Prepare materials and present updates to senior management as required** , and support delivery of assigned initiatives across the change lifecycle.

***Skills***

* Custody and operational background or experience
* Subject matter knowledge across custody capabilities. (e.g. Corporate Actions, Income, SWIFT, Settlements, Tax and Corporate Governance)
* Strong analytical skills
* Prior experience of successfully delivering change in a complex environment whilst managing competing environments, and delivering projects using Agile and Waterfall techniques
* Proven change agent with track record of delivery
* Integration and understanding of impact on Data Management
* Track record of engagement with complex clients, solutioning operating models and translating requirements into feature function capability for State Street Custody platform
* Familiarity with industry integration tools and their applicability in shortening the chain of custody across the investment lifecycle
* Strong stakeholder management skills with an ability to navigate organization through the solution delivery cycle
* Agile Development a plus

**Experience**

* Seasoned Officer with 5\+ years' experience in Securities Services
* Worked in Product organizations in prior roles
* Operated at a global level
* Prior experience working in Operations and/or technology
* Consultative experience working with institutional investors
* Strong team leadership and management skills
* Track record of solving data integration challenges across complex and at scale services

**Outcomes expected from the roles**

* In depth understanding of asset servicing product and related data management.
* Proactive input and idea generation for product development roadmap
* Maintain up to date understanding of regulatory headwinds and other industry disruptors and industry bodies that could impact the area
* Responsible for issue and risk escalation
* Project /initiative ownership as requested, with appropriate reporting (with PMO) of prioritized and approved change
* Appropriate governance and audit trail on documentation of all key decisions and actions.

**Split of role:**

* Product Design \& Development: 45%
* Business Analysis: 45%
* Market / Client interaction: 10%

**About State Street**
======================

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.


We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.


As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, gene…

Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.


Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.


What You'll Do


Go\-to\-Market Strategy


* Define and execute GTM plans for driving Informatica growth through product launches, new features, and market expansions
* Partner with sales and product management to shape sales plays and sales programs based on market and customer insights
* Develop launch tiers and coordinate cross\-functional readiness across Sales, Marketing, Support and Renewal teams

Positioning \& Messaging

Sales Enablement


* Create high\-impact sales tools including pitch decks, battlecards, one\-pagers, demo scripts, and objection handling guides

jobs.title: Lead Software Support Engineer – Locomotives & Trainsets
jobs.description:
**Hello Visionary!**
====================



At Siemens Mobility, we empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for individuals who are eager to learn, grow, and make a real impact—today and in the future. If that sounds like you, then you could be an outstanding addition to our vibrant team.



Siemens Mobility is an independently managed company of Siemens AG. Our core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology, and related services. By delivering innovative mobility solutions, we make travel easier, more enjoyable, and more efficient for millions of people every day.


**We are looking for**
----------------------


**TCMS Software Manager – Software Configuration \& Change Management**



**You’ll make a difference by**
-------------------------------


### **Your Responsibilities**


* Own Software Configuration Management (SCM), Software Release Management, and Software Change Management throughout the software lifecycle.


* Define and maintain Software Configuration Management Plans (SCMP), software baselines, version control, branching strategies, and release processes.


* Plan and manage software releases for development, integration, validation, commissioning, maintenance, and customer delivery.


* Define software release scope, schedules, and deployment plans aligned with project milestones.


* Coordinate with Project Management, Technical Management, System Engineering, Software Development, V\&V, Integration, Commissioning, Site Management, Quality, Functional Safety, and customer teams to ensure timely software delivery.


* Act as the primary interface for software configuration, release, and change management activities across projects.


* Review customer requests, defect reports, engineering changes, and commissioning feedback to define software release content and priorities.


* Lead Software Change Management, including Change Requests (CRs), Problem Reports (PRs), Engineering Change Requests (ECRs), and perform technical impact analysis.


* Organize Software Change Control Board (CCB) meetings and drive approved changes through implementation and closure.


* Decide software release readiness and approve software baselines for integration, validation, commissioning, and customer deployment.


* Ensure software releases are verified, traceable, and compliant with project quality processes and railway safety standards.


* Coordinate software deliveries across multiple projects, product variants, and global engineering locations.


* Support commissioning and site teams by managing software fixes, patches, emergency releases, and field issue resolutions.


* Monitor software release status, configuration metrics, change progress, and delivery KPIs, providing regular status updates to project stakeholders.


* Drive continuous improvement of software configuration, release, and change management processes while mentoring engineering teams on best practices.



**Desired Skills and Experience**
---------------------------------


* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.


* 8–10 years of experience in railway, rolling stock, embedded systems, or safety\-critical software development.


* Minimum 3 years of experience in Software Management, Software Configuration Management, Release Management, or Change Management.


* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Software V\-Model, Configuration Management, Release Management, and Change Management.


* Hands\-on experience with configuration management tools such as Git, SVN, Azure DevOps, ClearCase, or equivalent.


* Experience with Requirements Management tools such as Polarion, IBM DOORS, or equivalent.


* Experience with Change Management tools such as JIRA, Redmine, Azure DevOps, or equivalent.


* Knowledge of build management, software packaging, continuous integration, and deployment processes.


* Good understanding of TCMS software architecture, embedded control systems, and railway communication protocols such as MVB, WTB, Ethernet, and TRDP.


* Good knowledge of railway standards including EN 50126, EN 50128, EN 50129, EN 50657, IEC 61131\-3, and IEC 61375\.


* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, planning, communication, analytical, and decision\-making skills.


* Experience working with global engineering teams and international customers is preferred.



**Why Join Us?**
----------------



At Siemens Mobility, we value your unique identity and perspective. We are committed to creating equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Bring your authentic self, and together, let’s shape a better tomorrow.



This role is based in Bangalore, with occasional travel within India and abroad. In return, you’ll get the opportunity to work with teams shaping the future of mobility across the globe.



We’re Siemens. Over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time, in more than 200 countries. We’re committed to equality, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

**About WorkIndia:** 




 WorkIndia is India's largest blue\- and grey\-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23\.7 crore blue\-collar individuals across India.
 



 WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 We're looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the Centre of Excellence — WorkIndia's central matchmaking engine. You'll own product strategy and outcomes across the end\-to\-end hiring funnel, translating company strategy into a roadmap that improves experience and retention on both sides of the marketplace, alongside driving candidate growth.
 



  





 You will lead a team and work closely with the Head of Product, business leads across the org, and Engineering/Data partners whose infrastructure your roadmap depends on.
 



 This role requires strong product judgment on a genuinely hard, two\-sided problem — what looks like a candidate\-side fix is often the difference between an employer renewing or churning.
 



  





**About the Centre of Excellence (CoE):** 




 The CoE owns WorkIndia's central matchmaking engine — the capability that drives world\-class matching by solving for the end\-to\-end hiring funnel. This manifests as improved experience and retention on both sides of the marketplace. Additionally, CoE carries the responsibility for candidate supply — acquisition and reactivation.
 



  





**What You'll Do:** 





 Strategic Ownership
 



* Own and evolve the CoE product strategy in service of WorkIndia's matchmaking goals
* Translate company goals into a clear CoE roadmap
* Balance near\-term KPI delivery with longer\-term platform investments that unlock them




 User Thinking \& Product Judgment
 



* Build deep fluency in consumer behaviour and the drivers of activation and retention
* Ground every roadmap decision in real candidate and employer outcomes, not proxy metrics




 Business \& Product Leadership
 



* Own outcomes, not features: growth, retention, and long\-term matchmaking capability
* Manage and grow a cross\-functional team spanning product management and analytics
* Partner closely with marketing and engineering on channel and delivery strategy
* Represent CoE in cross\-functional forums where outcomes are shared with other business units




 Execution \& Systems Thinking
 



* Drive roadmap sequencing across near\-term fixes and longer\-term platform bets
* Convert repeated operational patterns into scalable product systems rather than one\-off fixes
* Push for systems that hold up at significant scale, in coordination with platform teams




 Data \& Decision Making
 



* Own the CoE metrics tree and use data to prioritise across the charter

**Team \& Reporting:** 



* **Reports to** 
 : Head of Product
* **Directly manages** 
 : A team spanning product management and analytics
* **Key partners** 
 : Marketing, Engineering \& Data, other product business units, Design



  





**What We're Looking For:** 



* 9\+ years of Product Management experience, with a track record of owning large, metric\-accountable product areas
* Demonstrated ability to drive both growth and retention/matching\-quality metrics
* Strong systems thinking and comfort resolving ambiguity
* Deep data fluency
* Experience managing a cross\-functional team
* Marketplace or two\-sided consumer product experience strongly preferred



  





**Why Join WorkIndia?** 



* **Impact:** 
 Be a part of a mission\-driven company that impacts millions of lives daily

 High ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company culture
